'''Class Red''' was a categorization level used by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] to classify their information. The blueprints for the [[Foreign Intruder Defense Organism]] was classified as Class Red by NRI.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
